summary.headline: Advantia Health secures $716K in annual savings across 7 sourced categories
summary.narrative: Treya Partners’ 2022 strategic-sourcing program delivered $684.9K in fully validated, recurring savings and a further $31.5K under active negotiation, bringing total identified value to $716K a year.  Savings are already flowing from five completed categories—including Billing Systems, Medical Supplies and two IUD initiatives—while Sonography Services and Lab Services are in the midst of roll-out and IT Managed Services is in late-stage vendor analysis.  Key wins were achieved through incumbent renegotiations, distributor consolidation and a shift to an in-house service model.
